N, H, W = 120, 720, 1280
SRC_CX, SRC_CY = 275.0, 258.0

def ellipse_alpha(cx, cy, rx, ry, sigma=2.0):

    d = ((xx-cx)/rx)**2 + ((yy-cy)/ry)**2
    hard = (d <= 1).astype(np.float32)
    return feather(hard, sigma)


def over(dst, rgb, alpha):
    a = alpha[..., None]
    return dst*(1-a) + rgb*a


def build_clean_plate(src):
    \"\"\"Remove the orange ball from frame zero using nearby table texture.\"\"\"
    plate = src.copy()
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W]
    core = (((xx-SRC_CX)/50.0)**2 + ((yy-SRC_CY)/46.0)**2 < 1.0).astype(np.float32)
    mask = feather(core, 5.0)

    # Samples 70 px to either side preserve those local variations and avoid a flat patch.
    xl = np.clip(xx-72, 0, W-1)

    left = src[yy, xl]

    plate = over(plate, synth, mask)

    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(src.astype(np.uint8), cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
    r, g, b = src[...,0], src[...,1], src[...,2]
    chroma = (r > 106) & (r.astype(np.int16)-g.astype(np.int16) > 18) & (hsv[...,0] < 25) & (hsv[...,1] > 48)
    m = ((dist < 1.12) & chroma).astype(np.uint8)*255
    m = cv2.morphologyEx(m, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((11,11),np.uint8))
    # Retain only the main local component.
    n, lab, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m)
    k = 1 + np.argmax(stats[1:, cv2.CC_STAT_AREA])

    x0,y0,x1,y1 = 218,211,334,307

    return crop, acrop, x0, y0

    rb = cv2.warpAffine(ball, M, (w,h), flags=cv2.INTER_CUBIC, borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
    ra = cv2.warpAffine(alpha, M, (w,h), flags=cv2.INTER_CUBIC, borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
    return rb, ra

    nw, nh = max(2,round(rb.shape[1]*scale)), max(2,round(rb.shape[0]*scale))
    rb = cv2.resize(rb,(nw,nh),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)

    dx0,dy0=max(0,x0),max(0,y0); dx1,dy1=min(W,x1),min(H,y1)

        paste_sprite(frame,ball,balpha,cx,cy,scale,rotation)
        frames[i]=np.clip(frame+0.5,0,255).astype(np.uint8)

    save(frames,CASE)
